name: Strawberry-Lemon "Butterfly" Cupcakes with White Fudge Pretzels (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Pilsbury strawberry cake mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
TO MAKE THE CUPCAKES: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners and set aside.
Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15.25 oz) box strawberry cake mix
1 cup water
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Fill the muffin liners halfway-full with batter (about ¼-cup each). Place in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 19-23 minutes. Remove from oven and allow cupcakes to cool slightly, 5 min. Carefully transfer cupcakes to a wire rack and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.

TO DECORATE THE CUPCAKES: Use a butter knife to spread the frosting over the top of each cupcake in an even layer. Working one at a time, create a "butterfly" on each cupcake using chocolate candies for the "body," dipped pretzels for the "wings," and sprinkles for the "antenna." (If you don't have lemon frosting, use white frosting and add yellow food coloring to get your desired color.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (16 oz) tub lemon frosting
½ cup chocolate candies
1 cup white fudge coated pretzels
1 tbsp rainbow sprinkles

instructions.primary_message: Show off your creations, share, and enjoy!
